what: A worker's own transcript, saved to disk by default, sometimes carried sensitive data a person never meant to leave their own machine. Every worker's reply and failure log were written to a shared run directory the same way regardless of what they contained.
rule: A job may declare that its own transcript must never be written to disk, and a configured sensitive path may require that declaration before a job touching it is allowed to run at all.
fix: Enforcement: such a job's saved reply and failure log are replaced with a fixed placeholder on disk (the real text is still used in memory for that same run), and a job whose own context or outputs match a configured sensitive path without the declaration refuses before it ever starts. Regression coverage is in `tests/field-lessons-batch-x.test.mjs`.
